title: Box plot
description:
A box plot summarizes `value_column` per `category_column`: the box spans the first to
the third quartile with the median inside, whiskers reach the furthest values within
1.5 IQR, and points beyond are outliers. See `:help dbdash-chart-types`.

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 60)
SELECT CASE i % 3 WHEN 0 THEN 'api' WHEN 1 THEN 'web' ELSE 'db' END AS service,
       20 + (i * 37) % 60 + CASE WHEN i % 17 = 0 THEN 120 ELSE 0 END AS ms
FROM n

show.title: boxdraw (default): outliers, means
show.description:
One box per service; `show_outliers` (default on) marks values past the whiskers with •,
`show_means` marks the mean with +. `colors` sets one color per category.

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 60)
SELECT CASE i % 3 WHEN 0 THEN 'api' WHEN 1 THEN 'web' ELSE 'db' END AS service,
       20 + (i * 37) % 60 + CASE WHEN i % 17 = 0 THEN 120 ELSE 0 END AS ms
FROM n

show.title: renderer: vertical
show.description:
`renderer: vertical` draws upright boxes, one column per category, with a value axis on
the left (`:DbDashStyle boxplot vertical`).

query.sql:

show.title: one box (no category), whiskers: [10, 90]
show.description:
Without `category_column` all values make one box. `whiskers: [10, 90]` puts the
whiskers at the 10th and 90th percentiles; the rest are outliers.
